# Commands (partitor 0.10.1)

Every command and option of `partitor`. The operator guide (`docs/operator/guide.md`) shows the usual order of work; this page lists everything. The same data is in `docs/cli.json`.

Run `partitor` with no command for the menu. Most commands take an item id: `12` or `2026-10-0012`.

## `partitor menu`

Recent items and new from inbox (default).

## `partitor new`

Wizard for an inbox PDF.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `n` | inbox number (default: ask) |
| `--jobs` | worker processes of the analysis and the build: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto) |

## `partitor list`

All library items, or those matching words.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `words` | e.g. Schein (composer, title, part, id) |

## `partitor show`

One item: status, parts, settings and what is not built yet.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |

## `partitor plan`

Choose paper, staff size and fold-outs of a part by its page turns (read-only until you pick an option; partitor plan --help).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `words` | a part or group, then the option number to set; default: groups and parts with a bad turn |
| `--group` `NAME=PARTS` | try a group the item does not have, e.g. AltTen=Alto,Tenor (part names or numbers): built in a temporary copy and shown; repeat for more groups |
| `--all` | show every option (default: the option as built and the best of each paper) |

## `partitor rebuild`

Build; with parts or groups: only those (the other part files stay).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `parts` | numbers (3, 2-4), names (Trombones, Bass Trombone) or all; default: every part |
| `--jobs` | worker processes: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto) |

## `partitor pages`

The pages of a built part and the turn after each; --move PAGE=N moves a system to the next page.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `part` | one part or group, name or number |
| `--move` `PAGE=N` | move the last N systems of PAGE to the next page (N negative: bring the first systems of the next page up); the part is paged again |
| `--clear` | drop the manual page breaks and the pins of the part |
| `--dry-run` | show the pages after --move, save nothing |

## `partitor repage`

New page breaks from the saved lines: turns while resting, manual breaks (no analysis, no build).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `parts` | numbers, names or all; default: every built part |

## `partitor proof`

Draw proof.pdf again (names, ambitus, bar numbers, letters).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |

## `partitor expand`

One step larger: one more page, then more space between staves; saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `part` | one part or group only (default: all) |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor contract`

One step smaller: one page less, then less space between staves; saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `part` | one part or group only (default: all) |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor bars`

Bar numbers and rehearsal marks (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor parts`

Part names, parts not extracted, parts joined (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor groups`

Group scores: several parts printed together (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor meta`

Title, subtitle and composer (menu); saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `--build` | build after the edit |

## `partitor reid`

Old YYYY-NNN item: new id YYYY-MM-NNNN (renames files).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 (the old id) |

## `partitor rename`

Folder name follows the title and composer.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |

## `partitor analyse`

Analyse the source again (proof, allocation).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 (or --all) |
| `--yes` | ask nothing; open choices stay for rebuild |
| `--all` | every library item, as --yes |
| `--join` `pP:N` | no system ends after staff N of source page P: two systems the analysis took apart are one (p5:4); saved, kept by every analysis; then analyse |
| `--unjoin` `pP:N` | take a join back |
| `--drop` `pP.sN` | leave a whole system out (a title, a piece of another work above the music): p1.s1; no part reads it, it counts no bars, every analysis keeps it; not analysed, not built |
| `--undrop` `pP.sN` | put a dropped system back (choices ask for its parts) |

## `partitor set`

Change settings; saved, not built (--build: build too).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | 12 or 2026-10-0012 |
| `pairs` | title=..., gap=11, pages=3, ...; one part: "Continuo:pages=4"; none: list every key with its value and default |
| `--build` | build after the change |

## `partitor log`

Print a run log (needs PARTITOR_LOG_DIR; docs/OPERATING.md).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `which` | 1 = the newest log (default), 2 = the one before, or a file name |
| `--tail` `N` | only the last N lines |
| `--list` | one line per run (the newest 20) |

## `partitor pieces`

List the pieces of a PDF: runs of music pages (no library, no files written).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pdf` | the score PDF |

## `partitor detect`

Analyse a PDF without the library: writes layout.yaml and the preview (then edit it, then build).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pdf` | the score PDF |
| `--pages` | pages to analyse: N or A-B (default: all) |
| `--parts` | part names, comma separated, top staff first (default: read from the printed labels) |
| `--title` | title (default: read from the PDF) |
| `--subtitle` | subtitle |
| `--composer` | composer (default: read from the PDF) |
| `--dpi` | analysis resolution (400) |
| `--page-header-sp` | text above a page's first staff farther than this, in staff spaces, is dropped (page title, running header) |
| `--out` | output folder (default: <pdf name>.partitor next to the PDF) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing layout.yaml |
| `--jobs` | worker processes for the page analysis: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto) |

## `partitor build`

Build the parts of a PDF from its layout.yaml (no library); options override the layout.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pdf` | the score PDF (run detect first) |
| `--pages` | pages to build: N or A-B (as in detect) |
| `--out` | folder of layout.yaml and the parts (default: <pdf name>.partitor next to the PDF) |
| `--paper` | paper size (letter) Values: `a4`, `ledger`, `letter`. |
| `--scale` | largest size, 1 = source size (default: up to --max-staff-mm) |
| `--gap` | staff spaces between staves, the widest (10) |
| `--min-gap` | smallest space between staves, to save a page turn (7) |
| `--clearance` | least space between the ink of two lines, in staff spaces (1) |
| `--page-count` | force this many pages |
| `--min-staff-mm` | smallest staff height, mm (5) |
| `--ink` | ink strength (normal) Values: `normal`, `darker`. |
| `--bar-numbers` | bar number at each line start, or none (start) Values: `start`, `none`. |
| `--bar-raise` | least height of a bar number above the staff, staff spaces (1) |
| `--bar-size` | bar number size, staff spaces (2) |
| `--margin-top` | top margin, mm (15) |
| `--margin-bottom` | bottom margin, mm (15) |
| `--margin-side` | side margin, mm (15) |
| `--gutter` | mm added at the spine in double-sided print (5) |
| `--duplex` | double-sided print; auto = over 2 pages (auto) Values: `auto`, `on`, `off`. |
| `--large` | also a large-print copy per part (on) Values: `on`, `off`. |
| `--reflow` | cut new lines at barlines for a larger staff (off; on hold) Values: `on`, `off`. |
| `--max-staff-mm` | largest staff height, mm (8) |
| `--title-page` | title page for 3+ pages of music printed double-sided (auto) Values: `auto`, `off`. |
| `--rests` | compress = empty staves and rest-only bars become multi-bar rests (compress) Values: `compress`, `keep`. |
| `--rest-bar` | H-bar of a multi-bar rest: engraved = thin serifs (as in Bravura), bold = thicker, heavy = the look of 0.8.30 (engraved) Values: `engraved`, `bold`, `heavy`. |
| `--jobs` | worker processes: a number or auto (default: PARTITOR_JOBS, else auto) |
| `--only` `NAME` | build these parts or groups only |

## Menu keys of one item

The keys of the item menu: `a`, `b`, `c`, `e`, `f`, `g`, `h`, `k`, `l`, `m`, `n`, `p`, `r`, `s`, `t`, `v`, `x`, `y`. The guide explains each key.
